hook.line: You already say quiero and puedo. Today you find out why they look so odd next to querer and poder, and you get every other person for free.
hook.en: —Do you want a coffee? —No, thanks. Can you do Monday?

examples.en: Tomás can't make it on Monday.

examples.es: La reunión empieza a las once.

examples.en: I don't understand the email, do you?

rule:
Some verbs change a vowel in the middle when you stress it.

querer: quiero, quieres, quiere, queremos, quieren
poder: puedo, puedes, puede, podemos, pueden

e becomes ie, o becomes ue. The endings are the ones you already know.

The change happens in four forms: yo, tú, él/ella/usted and ellos/ustedes. Nosotros keeps the plain vowel: queremos, podemos. Write the four changed forms in a list and they make the shape of a boot, with nosotros sticking out on its own.

Same pattern: empezar (empiezo, empezamos), entender (entiendo, entendemos), and soon preferir (prefiero), jugar (juego) and venir (vienes). Tener does it too, except in tengo: tienes, tiene, tienen, but tenemos.

The dictionary won't warn you. When you meet a new verb, check its yo form once.
smallPrint: These are stem-changing verbs (e→ie, o→ue, and u→ue in jugar). Some teachers call them boot verbs.
soundTip: Say ie as one quick syllable: QUIE-ro, not ki-E-ro. Ue is like the 'we' in 'well': PUE-do.

readAndPick.es: Mariana no puede a las ocho.
options: Mariana can't make it at eight.
I can't make it at eight.
We can't make it at eight.

readAndPick.es: Vale y yo entendemos el horario.
options: Vale and I understand the timetable.

readAndPick.es: La fiesta empieza a las ocho.
options: I start the party at eight.

yourTurn.prompt: Ask a friend if they want a coffee.
yourTurn.why: Tú is inside the boot: e becomes ie, quieres.
Nosotros is outside the boot, so no change: queremos.

yourTurn.prompt: Say: Vale can't make it on Monday.
yourTurn.why: Él/ella is inside the boot: o becomes ue, puede.

yourTurn.prompt: Say: I don't understand the email.
yourTurn.why: Yo is inside the boot: entender becomes entiendo.

yourTurn.prompt: Say: The meeting starts at nine.
yourTurn.answer: La reunión empieza a las nueve.
yourTurn.why: Empezar changes e to ie: empieza.

yourTurn.prompt: Ask a group of friends if they want bread.
yourTurn.why: Ustedes is inside the boot: quieren.

yourTurn.prompt: Ask a stranger politely if they can help you.
yourTurn.why: Usted uses the él/ella form, which is inside the boot: puede.

pitfalls.why: Nosotros sits outside the boot: the vowel stays e.
The yo form is inside the boot: quiero.
Empezar is a boot verb: empieza.

personal: What do you want right now, and what can't you do this week? Write two lines: Quiero… and No puedo el…
